pageTitle: Share the Skills Learned in "Hypostatic Symphony" to Win Primogem Rewards!
name: Share the Skills Learned in "Hypostatic Symphony" to Win Primogem Rewards!
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ The "Hypostatic Symphony" challenge is already available in-game. How skilled are you in defeating these fierce opponents? Got any tips for me? Come and take part in the "Hypostatic Symphony" Topic Event. Share your tips for completing challenges~ Travelers who participate successfully will have the opportunity to win Primogems!
